title: Deep Review Module Map
description: One mapping lane's territory report. PRODUCER: Phase 1 lanes (01-map/<lane>.json). CONSUMER: Phase 2 lenses, which use it to target files rather than sweep 70k LOC blind.

modules.description: One entry per coherent module in scope. A module is anything with an interface and an implementation — not necessarily one file.

responsibility.description: One sentence. If you need 'and' twice, it probably does too much — say so in suspicions.

depth.description: deep = lots of behaviour behind a small interface. shallow = interface nearly as complex as the implementation (a pass-through). Judgement call — say why in notes.

seams.description: Places where behaviour could be altered without editing in that place — where an interface already lives, or obviously should.

suspicions.description: Leads for Phase 2, NOT findings. Do not investigate deeply — flag and move on. Phase 2 lenses decide.

coverage_notes.description: Anything in scope you could NOT assess, and why. An honest gap beats a confident guess.
